title: crataegus scabrifolia
intro: Crataegus scabrifolia, commonly known as the scabrous hawthorn, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, improving cardiovascular health, and reducing inflammation due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus scabrifolia are primarily attributed to its ability to act as a vasodilator, improving circulation and reducing the risk of cardiovascular disease. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
